findings.title: Country access trusts client-supplied X-Forwarded-For without TRUST_PROXY gate
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-290 / OWASP API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization
findings.exploit_path: When `CountryAccessService` rules block the attacker's geography, send HTTP requests with header `X-Forwarded-For: <allowed-country-resident-ip>`; `CountryAccessGuard._resolve_client_ip` returns the forged left-most XFF entry before `request.client`, bypassing GeoIP enforcement unless MaxMind maps the spoofed IP to an allowed country.
findings.disprover_notes: Independent disprover (Composer pass, separate from hunter): threat-model trust boundary #1 requires XFF trust only when `TRUST_PROXY` is configured; `app.state.trust_proxy` is parsed in `main.py` but never consulted in the guard. `TRUST_PROXY=false` does not prevent honoring attacker-controlled XFF. ALB-style proxies that append rather than replace XFF still leave attacker-chosen first hop. Rejection paths (service inactive, bypass paths) do not mitigate active rules.
findings.remediation: Implement NestJS-parity `trust_proxy` helper: use `request.client.host` unless proxy chain is validated against `TRUST_PROXY` CIDRs, then parse right-most trusted hop; add unit tests mirroring reference; align with rate-limit IP resolution.

findings.title: Container image enables uvicorn forwarded-allow-ips=*
findings.exploit_path: Any host that can reach the container port can supply `X-Forwarded-For` and influence uvicorn `request.client.host`, weakening IP-based controls that rely on client address (global IP rate limit uses `request.client.host` at `rate_limit_guard.py:215-217`).
findings.disprover_notes: Intentional for ALB-terminated TLS behind private networking; risk depends on whether port 3000 is ever exposed without an overwriting edge proxy.
findings.remediation: Set `--forwarded-allow-ips` to ALB CIDRs or remove `*` when `TRUST_PROXY` lists explicit hops; document required network posture.

findings.title: WebSocket admin-broadcast authorizes JWT role claim only
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-613 / OWASP API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization
findings.exploit_path: Demoted admin retains valid access token; `handle_admin_broadcast` checks `user.role == "admin"` from handshake JWT without live MongoDB/allowlist re-check used for REST feature flags.
findings.disprover_notes: Role forgery without private key rejected; stale-admin window matches pre-mitigation REST pattern now fixed via `assert_feature_flag_admin`. Blast radius limited to Socket.IO namespace broadcast.
findings.remediation: Re-resolve admin status from `AuthService` on connect and before `admin-broadcast`; revoke socket session on demotion.

findings.title: Redis rate-limit fallback may split brain across instances
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-799 / OWASP API4:2023 Unrestricted Resource Consumption
findings.exploit_path: When Redis unavailable, `FallbackRateLimitBackend` uses per-process memory; attacker rotates across instances or waits cooldown to exceed global limits.
findings.disprover_notes: Depends on `RATE_LIMIT_STORAGE=redis`, instance count, and Redis SLO; intentional resilience trade-off.
findings.remediation: Document fail-closed option; alert on fallback activation; consider shedding instead of anonymous memory buckets in production.

findings.title: ClamAV scanning disabled by default
findings.exploit_path: Authenticated user uploads malware-bearing files when `UPLOAD_VIRUS_SCAN` is not true; magic-byte checks pass but no INSTREAM scan runs.
findings.disprover_notes: Operational configuration choice; threat model assumes `UPLOAD_VIRUS_SCAN=true` in hardened deployments.
findings.remediation: Require `UPLOAD_VIRUS_SCAN=true` in production `validate_env` when `/uploads` is exposed.

findings.title: GraphQL complexity, depth, and Redis budgets not enforced
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-400 / OWASP API4:2023 Unrestricted Resource Consumption
findings.disprover_notes: `GraphqlProtectionExtension` enforces depth (`assert_query_depth`), complexity (`estimate_query_complexity`), Redis budget (`assert_budget_available`/`consume_budget`), and concurrency lease (`try_acquire_concurrency`). Wired via `build_graphql_schema` in `schema.py:80-93`.

findings.title: Unauthenticated background job enqueue via public example endpoint
findings.disprover_notes: `create_app` omits example routers when `NODE_ENV=production` (`main.py:431-435`). Route remains `@public` in dev/staging only — document as non-prod surface.
findings.remediation: Optional: add auth even in dev or move to conformance harness.

findings.title: CountryAccessGuard never mounted in ASGI pipeline
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-284 / OWASP API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization
findings.disprover_notes: `CountryAccessDependency` is registered on `app.router.dependencies` after JWT and before rate limit; `check_access` runs per request. Middleware variant exists but dependency wiring satisfies enforcement path.

findings.title: REST CORS defaults to wildcard origins with credentials enabled
findings.disprover_notes: `assert_rest_production_origins` (`parsers.py:407-418`) fails fast when `NODE_ENV=production` and `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` is empty or `*`. Wildcard default applies to non-production only.
findings.remediation: None for production; document dev default.

findings.title: Feature-flag admin authorization trusts JWT role claim only
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-613 / OWASP API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization
findings.disprover_notes: `require_feature_flag_admin` delegates to `assert_feature_flag_admin`, which re-reads MongoDB role and `FEATURE_FLAG_ADMIN_EMAILS` on each mutation/list request.

findings.title: Conformance harness SSRF to loopback
findings.disprover_notes: `validate_env` raises if `CONFORMANCE_HARNESS_ENABLED=true` and `NODE_ENV=production`; route not registered otherwise.
findings.remediation: None required for production; keep production guard.

findings.title: CSRF not enforced for Bearer-only API clients
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-352 / OWASP A01 Broken Access Control
findings.disprover_notes: By design: `should_enforce_csrf` returns false when Authorization Bearer present; cookie-based sessions still require double-submit.

findings.title: Outbound HTTP client allows private URLs when env flag set
findings.disprover_notes: Default blocks RFC1918/loopback; flag is explicit operator override for conformance/dev.
findings.remediation: Consider blocking flag in production `validate_env` if not already.
